permit.applies: The worker applies (Form 3, by email to Customs & Immigration) from outside the Islands; the prospective employer sponsors and answers for full repatriation costs.
permit.first: The vacancy advertised in the Falkland Islands for at least 7 days, and Customs & Immigration satisfied that no Falkland Islands Status or Permanent Residence Permit holder is suitable and available.

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, Customs & Immigration: Work Permit
sources.said: A work permit is ordinarily valid for the length of the individual’s contract and is job and employer specific. The period of validity of a work permit may be extended but must not exceed four years in total. … The employment vacancy to have been advertised sufficiently well in the Falkland Islands (in any case for at least 7 days). To satisfy the Customs & Immigration Service that there are no ‘Falkland Islands Status holders’ or ‘Falkland Islands Permanent Residence Permit holders’ suitable and available to fill such vacancy. Be prepared and to signify sponsorship and responsibility for full repatriation costs of the individual

sources.title: Falkland Islands Customs & Immigration, Form 3: Application for Work Permit (September 2025)
sources.said: An application fee is payable. A fee will be charged for an extension of an existing permit. All applications should be submitted via email to permits@customs.gov.fk … We aim to process complete applications within eight working days.

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, Customs and Immigration: FAQ & General Information
sources.said: Ordinarily no, in the first instance work permits must be applied for from outside of the Falklands. Visitors cannot apply for work permits from within the Falklands. However, where it is obvious that there are no permanent residents available to fill a vacancy, the Principal Immigration Officer may authorise a visitor to work under the authority of a “short term work permission”. Current rules only allow a visitor to work in the Islands for a maximum of three months in aggregate in any period of twelve months.
